policy: Only fixed design constants written in docs/PROTOCOL.md or configs/ before the protocol-frozen tag. Never a measured or result value.

constants.1: Nominal 1% label fraction; seed 1; one warm-up epoch; learning-rate grid 1e-4/1e-3 mantissas (configs/search.json)
constants.2: Seed 2; last two transformer blocks (PROTOCOL: PFT trainable components)
constants.4: Four images per class floor (D005); four LP views (D009); r=4 ablation; last-four-block ablation
constants.10: Nominal 10% fraction; rotation ±10 degrees; ten slowest epochs in the T_MAX rule; 10 gallery images (D013)
constants.12: Twelve DINOv2 blocks; LoRA on all 12 blocks (PROTOCOL)
constants.18: ResNet-18 baseline name when written without a preceding letter
constants.36: Main grid size 4 methods x 3 fractions x 3 seeds (PROTOCOL)
constants.100: Nominal 100% label fraction; LP C grid value 100 (configs/search.json)
constants.0.01: LP C grid; weight-decay grid value (configs/search.json)
constants.0.1: LP C grid; LoRA dropout; brightness/contrast jitter (PROTOCOL)
constants.0.5: Chance-level AUC reference line; probability midpoint in the threshold tie rule (PROTOCOL)
